caption: The image shows a rectangular plate with rounded edges, featuring a central scene and a decorated border. The central scene depicts a pastoral landscape: in the foreground, there are cows and sheep resting and grazing on grassy ground. A large tree occupies the left-middle area, with a barn-like building behind it to the left. Further back in the scene, there is a river or lake running horizontally, bordered by trees including tall, narrow ones resembling cypresses. Two small boats or people are visible on the water. Beyond the water, the land rises to gentle hills with groups of trees and at least two larger buildings or houses in the background. The sky is filled with scattered clouds. The plate's wide border is decorated with repeated patterns of large flowers and leaves intertwined with birds. The entire image is in grayscale tones, as the photograph is black and white.
title: Platter
